method: Independent source review of the immutable measured workdir, AGENTS.md, acceptance results, and held-out diagnostics

rule_map.incomplete_claim: AGENTS.md says draft visibility is shared through Articles.visibleArticle, but list, feed, and drafts visibility is separately encoded in the SQL predicate in Articles.listArticles.
rule_map.missing_rule: Password length is enforced during updateUser but not during register; the held-out diagnostic confirms a seven-character registration and login succeed.

present: Servant type-level routes and handler coverage
STM admission and per-client send queues
Hasql with PostgreSQL constraints and set-oriented list queries
jose-signed JWT and bcrypt password hashing
durable PostgreSQL export queue with SKIP LOCKED worker
opportunities: HTTP request and domain state are dynamic Aeson Value/Text/Maybe Int; no typed input records, Viewer, or status sum type
Db.runSql sends one JSONB parameter and receives one JSONB result for dynamic SQL; hasql-th and typed parameter/result codecs are unused
one MVar-protected Hasql connection serializes database access; no pool
migration files are applied by custom Db.openDb code; pg-migrate is unused
updateChecked takes a Bool shared flag and the shared path passes uid 0
focused rule tests exercise HTTP transitions, not pure domain functions

comparison_scope: This is one v2-prompt Servant pilot, not a same-prompt comparator to the earlier Rails, Phoenix, Loco, or IHP runs.
